limitations: Fit-boundary verification depends on actual-fit audit records; synthetic tests independently inspect builder inputs and perturb held-out labels/distributions.
Inner OOF predictions were not exported; parameter choice is checked against logged candidate scores, while pooled outer metrics are reconstructed from individual OOF records.
External access checks inspect the run's access log and guard tests; the validator does not reopen external responses.

configuration.scope: expanded development engineering pilot; exploratory internal comparisons, not final eight-drug repeated-CV or external validation
configuration.drug_selection_rule: same two coverage-prespecified drugs as v0.1; no performance selection or panel replacement
configuration.global_fold_rule: tissue-stratified known biological groups on the cancer-v2 development pool; identical global folds for all models and both drugs
configuration.endpoint: GDSC2 drug-response AUC within frozen exact drug-specific dose interval; higher = lower sensitivity
configuration.tuning_objective: minimum pooled inner OOF RMSE on original GDSC AUC; deterministic first-candidate tie break

feature.annotation_rule: exact-annotation protein_coding only, no full-development or external distribution filter
feature.rank: training log2TPM MAD descending, stable gene-ID tie break
feature.reo_encoding: raw-TPM exact order +1/-1, ties=0; missing is never a tie
feature.missing_rule: finite complete TPM only; fail and record unsupported missing inputs
feature.empty_feature_fallback: training mean, preserving failure and all test samples

elastic_net.path_rule: each fit computes alpha_max from its own training-standardized, tissue-projected X and y, divided by n*l1_ratio; never use outer training or held-out labels to supply an inner path
elastic_net.standardization: train-only feature mean/SD and target mean/population SD
elastic_net.tissue_handling: unpenalized FWL tissue effects after gene/REO construction; unseen tissue effect=0, retaining molecular prediction

random_forest.pair_filter_rule: train-only absolute within-tissue association with continuous response, stable feature-name tie break; apply frozen selected columns to validation/test
random_forest.tissue_handling: append full train-fit one-hot tissue to raw logTPM or raw REO features; unseen category all-zero; no raw-TPM gene residualization

configuration.timing_preflight: training-only weakest EN path and largest RF feature/leaf budget, no held-out score or hyperparameter selection
configuration.external_response_access: forbidden; CTRP response, curve index and old response table remain sealed
configuration.primary_comparison: REO EN200 versus strong expression EN2000 on identical OOF identities; RF within-family comparison is secondary
configuration.statistical_inference: pilot OOF points and per-fold stability only; no claim of reliable superiority, no confirmatory p-value or equivalence
configuration.cross_run_interpretation: v0.1 and v0.2 differ in cohort, folds, gene budget and path; changes cannot be attributed to gene budget alone
configuration.planned_full_analysis: fixed eight-drug 5 outer folds x 3 repeats, inner3, prior statistical freeze and then CTRP once

resources.memory_scope: whole single pilot process including input preparation and libraries; not isolated model memory

interpretation: Expanded engineering/development pilot only. Formal eight-drug repeated nested CV, uncertainty/permutation procedures and frozen external validation remain pending.
